## Bounded acceptance scope

This review covers `docs/research/04-game-design-review.md`, `docs/build/tasks/DESIGN-CRITIC.md` and corresponding dedicated-critique additions in PLAN, DELIVERY_AND_ACCEPTANCE and BUILD_GAME_REVISED. Production M1 source present in the candidate is outside this review. Neither the current game nor a late-stage gameplay critique is accepted by this documentation gate.

1. Accurate attributed primary-source claims, usable citations and honest access limits, with source facts distinguished from Siltwake inference. Directly verify consequential claims through available sources; report any retrieval limit.
2. Preserve the accepted campaign, richer-cel direction, six hulls, source geography, regional guidance, food/no thirst, evasion and recoverable loss. No superseded short-game cuts, unsupported new scope, copied commercial assets or unlabelled story spoilers.
3. Practical fresh non-author Astra xhigh critique after the full authored campaign/early M4, using actual ordinary-play evidence, prioritized concrete findings, separate severity/confidence, corrections and fresh re-review. Keep existing technical pair and human/GPU limits.
4. Cover relationships among flow, world/resources, fleet/building, survival/ecology/recovery, lore, assets, UI/audio/accessibility.
5. Procedure and evidence claims agree across the scoped documents. Research/preparation is not actual game validation.

Both reviewers received the same full scope, candidate/base, specification pointers, author/coordinator identities, source provenance and known evidence limits. Astra emphasizes design reasoning and cross-system scope; Sol emphasizes claim traceability and exact requirements, but each covers the full bounded scope. They may not read one another's initial findings or edit candidate files. Source retrieval needs no browser; any browser use must follow both fleet/repository rules and preserve task isolation.

## Finding dispositions and evidence limits

- No required corrections, rejected findings or unresolved blocking objections.
- Astra **N1 (optional P3)**: a rolling latest-100 Steam feed may eventually omit historical articles. Root addressed the suggested durability improvement in supplemental [retrieval metadata](DESIGN-PREP-R1-SOURCES.json), without changing accepted research claims. Four dated `count=1`, `enddate=publicationUnixSeconds+1` requests returned HTTP 200 and the exact S2–S5 announcement IDs/publication timestamps. Metadata includes retrieval UTC, URLs, titles and SHA-256 of each raw `contents` UTF-8 string. This avoids reliance on the moving latest-100 window; it does not guarantee the publisher will retain an immutable API forever. It is root's additional retrieval evidence, not a new independent reviewer verdict.
- Both reviewers checked substantive text, not unseen talk videos, inaccessible thesis content or actual game examples. Developer accounts establish reported intent/history, not independent effectiveness. Root made no browser/gameplay claim from the HTTP checks.
- The accepted scope is research fidelity, scope alignment and a usable future critic procedure. M1/gameplay, human enjoyment/surprise/duration and hardware performance remain unaccepted/unverified. The actual dedicated game-design critique is still scheduled after M3/early M4.
